visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with brown hair in a ponytail, wearing a white long-sleeved crop top, sits in a stadium seat. She looks shocked and covers her mouth while gazing at the field. The background shows tiered seating filled with a large crowd under a massive metal mesh roof structure. (2) The woman stands in front of a pink event backdrop featuring 'AAA 2025' text and balloon graphics. She gestures toward the backdrop and speaks excitedly. The lighting is bright and natural, suggesting an outdoor event area. (3) An outdoor scene near a stone wall shows a male hand holding a smartphone. The phone screen displays a photo of the woman in front of the backdrop. The woman stands beside him, looking down at the device with a dissatisfied facial expression. (4) A screen recording demonstrates an AI editing feature on the phone. The interface highlights the woman's face in the photo and shows various facial expression options. The background remains the event photo. (5) Fast-paced concert footage showing K-pop idols performing on a large, brightly lit stage. The camera zooms in significantly on a performer in a tan fringed jacket. Crowds of fans are visible in the foreground holding light sticks. (6) Another performance clip at night shows a girl group in pink outfits dancing on stage. Purple stage lights and large video screens are in the background. The footage then cuts to a male idol in a black outfit singing into a microphone. (7) The woman is back in the stadium seat at night. She points her phone at the stage while someone else shows the 'Circle to Search' feature on the screen. The stadium is illuminated by thousands of blue fan lights. (8) The woman stands outdoors near a stadium walkway at dusk. She holds a dark grey smartphone and speaks directly to the camera, gesturing with her free hand. She wears a grey cardigan over her crop top. (9) The screen transitions to a stark black background with a centered white 'SAMSUNG' logo.
